name: 0.security
long_description:
0.security helps software companies, large enterprises and critical infrastructure providers to find & fix security risks. With our open-source software infrastructure, enterprises can build & deploy AI security agents in their own environments with full control over their data and operations.

We just passed 1.5k GitHub stars, including engineers at Spotify, Palo Alto Networks, Microsoft, Google, Wiz, Red Hat, Mistral AI, and Dan Guido (CEO Trail of Bits). Our agents have found & fixed 30+ previously unknown vulnerabilities (0-days) in the Linux kernel, which runs on 3B+ devices, and 500+ CVEs including in government code from multiple countries. We work with critical infrastructure providers, large enterprise and are partnered with EY and defense organizations

Most AI security tools are cloud-based black boxes that enterprises can’t safely deploy across sensitive infrastructure. We solve this with open-source, self-hosted agents. Engineers adopt us for free, and enterprises pay to deploy and manage agents across their environments.

Global cybersecurity spending is projected to exceed $300 billion in 2026. We start with critical infrastructure providers, then expand across enterprise security workflows.

Both founders have built companies, won startup awards, and competed at the highest national level in sports. Doruk led Cyber & Autonomous Systems for the Swiss Mars Rover Team and co-founded Soothe Studios. Fabian co-founded the institutional quant fund Mellivora Capital and helped grow Crypto Finance (acq. by Deutsche Börse Group) from 10 to 100+ employees. Doruk is a former Swiss table tennis champion & trainer; Fabian is a former Swiss trampoline gymnastics champion.
one_liner: Sovereign AI security agents for enterprise
